name: accilium-skills
description: Agent skills from accilium's AI-native transformation, shared in public

plugins.name: ai-policy-assessment-skill
plugins.description: Checks an existing AI policy and answers two questions a management team asks: what does the law require of us that we have not covered, and where are we stricter than the law asks, at our own cost. Produces one self-contained HTML report — coverage figures, a risk-versus-strictness grid, and 27 criteria with the policy sentence each finding rests on. Triggers on: "check our AI policy", "rate our AI policy", "is our AI policy blocking the business", "what does the AI Act require of us". Do NOT use for writing a policy from scratch, a legal opinion, or an ISO 42001 certification audit.

plugins.name: case-cortex
plugins.description: Build and maintain a Case Cortex — a structured, living, machine-readable representation of a single bounded knowledge-work problem (a deal, a matter, an investigation, a research question) that agents and humans share as their reasoning substrate. Triggers on: "build a cortex for X", "start a new case", "seed my cortex", "ingest this into the cortex", "what does the cortex say about Y", "lint the cortex". Do NOT use for casual long-running tasks, one-shot research, or general-purpose wikis spanning multiple problems.
